title: Enterprise 10.6 general upgrade route and KV-specific bridge need scope clarification
problem: A general direct 10.0-to-10.6 release-line path does not settle the separately documented 10.2+ bridge for deployments using KV Store.

audiences: Customers and documentation readers evaluating the stated decision
exclusions: KV-specific prerequisite; not applied to Universal Forwarders or Cloud-managed upgrade routes.

impact.customerScenario: A reader plans an Enterprise or Heavy Forwarder upgrade with KV Store from 10.0 or lower.
impact.consequence: Treating the general graph as a complete KV Store prerequisite check can omit the narrower documented bridge.

confidence.rationale: Historical published observations are normalized without creating a new source review or numeric confidence score.

lifecycle.reason: No withdrawal, merge or supersession is recorded.

evidence.section: Upgrade the KV store server version — source-version prerequisite
evidence.statement: The audit records a KV-specific requirement to reach 10.2 or higher first for sources at 10.0 or lower.
